prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 行标题 · 年度目标拆解 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "目标" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 108px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "截止" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 4: header "关键结果" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 541px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"将年度目标与负责人、截止日期和可衡量的关键结果对应起来，便于跟踪执行。","reading":"读者先按目标定位行，再横向查看责任人、期限和结果；也可纵向比较各目标的期限和完成标准。关键结果最适合利用换行形成的行高。","groups":["目标与关键结果共同说明要达成什么；前者用于定位，后者提供衡量标准。","负责人和截止日期都是简短的执行信息，应便于快速纵向扫描。"],"keep_intact":["负责人姓名","截止日期，如 12-31","百分比、数值和英文缩写等结果指标"],"may_wrap":["关键结果中的中文叙述可在自然语义处换行","目标名称可在必要时换行，较长结果形成的行高可容纳这些换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [129, 67, 65, 458] · table 720×206px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [105, 67, 65, 482] · table 720×229px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [145, 80, 75, 419] · table 720×229px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"目标、负责人和截止日期均保持单行，便于按行定位和纵向比较；关键结果占据主要宽度，除第一条外均为单行，整体紧凑。","problems":"第一条关键结果在“毛利率”中间换行，第二行较短，阅读节奏略显突兀。","cause":"关键结果列宽458px，第一行恰好只能容纳“毛利”，剩余的“率”落到下一行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"关键结果列较宽，短结果容易保持单行；负责人和日期仍清晰完整。","problems":"前两个目标名称分别被拆成两行，第一条甚至将“标”单独留在第二行。行标题因此更难扫读，第二条也被迫增高。","cause":"目标列宽105px，文本区只有84px，不足以容纳较长目标名称；增加给关键结果的宽度未消除第一条结果的换行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"目标名称、负责人和日期均保持单行，执行信息列较宽松。","problems":"第三条关键结果的“下降一半”被拆开，末尾只有“半。”单独占一行，造成明显的视觉零碎和额外行高。","cause":"目标、负责人和截止列分别增至145、80和75px，挤占关键结果列，使其缩至419px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1A","widths":[137,67,65,450],"change":"在保留目标名称单行及负责人、日期紧凑布局的前提下，将关键结果列收窄8px，尝试让第一条在“毛利率”之前换行，使词语保持完整；总宽仍为719px。"},{"name":"r1B","widths":[133,67,65,454],"change":"以较小幅度收窄关键结果列，并将4px让给目标列，测试能否修正第一条的断词，同时保留第三条结果单行。"}]}
